# staff-postmortem

> Blameless Staff incident-review form. Evidence-first. Copy the template. Harborlot fills are fictional. docs/examples composites are anonymized, not company incidents.

## Primary

- [Template](docs/template.md): blank form (summary, quantified impact, UTC timeline, detection, systemic factors, what went well, SMART actions)
- [Checkout latency example](docs/example-checkout-latency.md): dense fictional Harborlot fill
- [Short spike example](docs/example-short-spike.md): fictional ~2 min identity 502
- [Silent push / webhook composite](docs/examples/silent-push-webhook.md): anonymized composite, not a public company incident
- [Examples index](docs/examples/README.md): fiction vs anonymized composite
- [References](docs/references.md): public structure links only

## Also

- [When to write](docs/when-to-write.md): severity threshold, when not to write a novel, 48-hour draft
- [Facilitation](docs/facilitation.md): HOW / timeline-first; schedule early; learning is not an action pile
- [Severity](docs/severity.md): Sev vs P
- [README](README.md): map
